nodes.label: RevenueCat Subscription Reconciliation Notes
nodes.rationale: Documents the RevenueCat/Supabase subscription drift investigation, webhook configuration fix, aggregate diff, access risk, and recommended backfill guidance.

nodes.label: Test Store App Scope Problem
nodes.rationale: The existing webhook was scoped to the RevenueCat Test Store app, so live App Store and Web Billing events were not covered.

nodes.label: Project-Wide Webhook Fix
nodes.rationale: Setting app_id to null makes the webhook project-wide across all RevenueCat apps in the Ickcheck project.

nodes.label: Subscription State Drift
nodes.rationale: RevenueCat reported 116 active subscriptions while Supabase had 432 raw active users, with 340 active rows past expiry.

nodes.label: Paid Access Risk
nodes.rationale: Stale active Supabase rows may grant paid access if client gating relies on subscription_status or tracking_quota rather than expiry or RevenueCat entitlement state.

nodes.label: Backfill Guidance
nodes.rationale: Recommends a staged read-only reconciliation and reviewed batch updates instead of a blind overwrite.

nodes.label: Susly Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Internal Vercel dashboard for Susly/IckCheck analytics, creator mock accounts, and Instagram clone mock profile management.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: Agents must read relevant Next.js docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding because this Next.js version has breaking changes.

nodes.label: Creator Account Management
nodes.rationale: Builds creator account management for listing, creating, disabling, enabling, and tracking login completion for creator accounts.

nodes.label: Bearer Token Authentication
nodes.rationale: Every request must use the provided API key as a bearer token, but it must only be used from a trusted backend/server layer.

nodes.norm_label: mark creator tool login completed endpoint
